summary: Verified Club Legacy slice + Showroom Share Card. Backend isolated SQLite pytest (test_owner_legacy_api.py, test_owner_staff_api.py, test_owner_staff.py) = 10/10 pass. Live preview READ-ONLY smoke: /api/owner/public/clubs/nope -> 404 'Club page not found.', /api/owner/net-worth no auth -> 401, with admin bearer -> 200 clubs=[], /api/owner/public/showroom/abc -> 404 'Showroom not found.'. Contract audit: no violations; shared/api_contract.json has /owner/public/clubs/{club_id}, /owner/net-worth, /owner/clubs/{club_id}/money-history (canonical /api/v2/owner/* with /api/owner/* aliases). Flutter widget tests `flutter test test/owner_console/` = 40/40 pass (includes new club_page_test.dart: public 5-tab layout, owner net worth + money history extra tabs, showroom share card dialog). Frontend UI (no login) /#/club-page/nope on desktop 1920 and mobile 390 renders the 'Club page unavailable / Club page not found.' error card; /#/showroom/abc renders 'Showroom unavailable / Showroom not found.' Flutter uses canvas rendering so DOM text extraction returned false but screenshots visually confirm both. Admin-login UI walkthrough was not driven headlessly end-to-end (Flutter CanvasKit has no DOM inputs and the live Supabase DB is write-protected), but code review confirms OwnerConsoleSection.legacy exists with title 'Club Page & Net Worth', Key 'owner-console-section-legacy' is wired, and OwnerClubPageSection surfaces the 'No club yet' empty state when the owner has no clubs - which matches the admin's state (net-worth clubs=[]). Widget tests already cover the owner console rendering of this section and the share card dialog, so no new regressions were introduced.
